run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the lexicographically maximum substring of a given string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample inputs to verify lexicographical maximum substring results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient algorithm than comparing all suffixes
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that finds the lexicographically largest suffix of a string
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iterates all suffixes and returns the lexicographically maximum one
